title: Finite adjunction assembly from reflected single-level triangles
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an arbitrary scheme $S$ with $\ell$ invertible, a projective-line presentation $p$ and map data $d$ [def-sp-tower-p1-adjunction-data], and the canonical etale-origin comparisons $h$ [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons]. Assume both triangle identities for the specified tower unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$ on all of $\mathscr C^+$. At each positive exponent $n+1$ there are FiniteMaps $f_m$ with the recorded tensor/pullback comparison, and an adjunction between its finite restricted functors. The image of every tower $\eta_M$ under evaluation, followed by $f_m$'s right-functor comparison and finite inverse image of pushEvaluation, is exactly its finite unit at $M_{n+1}$. Its finite counit at $K_{n+1}$ is exactly finite direct image of the inverse right comparison, followed by inverse pushEvaluation and the evaluation of $\varepsilon_K$. No tower adjunction is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Use the singleton realization and feed the assumed tower triangles to the single-level triangle theorem. Full faithfulness of bounded-below site comparison gives the two finite ordinary etale triangle identities for all bounded-below inputs.

proof.text: Use the retained canonical level comparison words to transport the finite diagonal and trace natural transformations to the full etale-origin domains. Exact inverse image, the rank-one twist and proper bounded-below direct image preserve these domains. The composite tensorEvaluation and pullEvaluation defines FiniteMaps.comparison and has exactly comparison_eq.

theorem towerP1_finite_adjunction_assembly (p : Presentation l E S hS) (d : Maps l E p)
    (h : EtaleOriginComparisons l E p d)
    (ht : (∀ M : C l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S),
      (p.F l E).map (eta l E d M) ≫ epsilon l E d ((left l E d).obj M) =
        𝟙 ((p.F l E).obj M.obj)) ∧
      (∀ K : C l E p.classes.base S,
        eta l E d ((rightRestricted l E d).obj K) ≫ (p.G l E).map (epsilon l E d K) =
          𝟙 ((p.G l E).obj K.obj))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (fm : FiniteMaps l E p n) (adj : finiteLeft l E fm ⊣ finiteRight l E fm),
      (∀ M : C l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S),
        (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E (ProjectiveLine S) n).map (eta l E d M) ≫
          fm.comparison.hom.app ((p.F l E).obj M.obj) ≫
            (finiteG l E p n).map
              (((p.operations.geometry (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).pushEvaluation n).hom.app M.obj) =
          (finiteDomain l E (ProjectiveLine S) n).ι.map
            (adj.unit.app ((evaluation l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S) n).obj M))) ∧
      (∀ K : C l E p.classes.base S,
        (finiteF l E S n).map (fm.comparison.inv.app K.obj) ≫
          ((p.operations.geometry (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).pushEvaluation n).inv.app
            ((p.G l E).obj K.obj) ≫ (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).map (epsilon l E d K) =
          (finiteDomain l E S n).ι.map
            (adj.counit.app ((evaluation l E p.classes.base S n).obj K)))
